title: The Lick Observatory Hamilton echelle spectrometer
what_was_studied: Optical design and high-resolution stellar spectroscopy capability
numerical_result: The instrument paper describes broad optical coverage at high resolving power for the Shane and Coude Auxiliary telescopes
remaining_question: The original paper does not establish modern long-term RV precision

title: The Twenty-Five Year Lick Planet Search
what_was_studied: Homogeneous re-reduction of the long Hamilton iodine-cell programme
numerical_result: The release contains more than 14000 velocities for 386 stars from 1987 to 2011; precision improved from about 10 m/s in 1992 to about 3 m/s in 1995
remaining_question: Instrument-era offsets and the damaged iodine cell limit naive combination with later data

title: Aldebaran b's temperate past uncovered in planet search data
what_was_studied: Multi-instrument reassessment of the long-period Aldebaran signal including Hamilton data
numerical_result: The analysis combined long baselines and found additional structure inconsistent with a single unchanging Keplerian description
remaining_question: Can wavelength-dependent activity models explain the residual periodicities?

title: Coude Auxiliary Telescope
what_was_studied: Present access context for the telescope feeding Hamilton
numerical_result: Lick states that the CAT is available only on a restricted basis
remaining_question: Restricted CAT access does not by itself prove Hamilton hardware availability or retirement
